business_problem: TSC needed to fuse millions of global information signals into actionable stakeholder intelligence fast enough for Fortune 500 clients while keeping latency low, uptime high, and sensitive workflows inside a secure cloud perimeter.
solution_summary: The Stakeholder Company uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: TSC needed to fuse millions of global information signals into actionable stakeholder intelligence fast enough for Fortune 500 clients while keeping latency low, uptime high, and sensitive workflows inside a secure cloud perimeter. BigQuery acts as the primary data warehouse and vector store for entity extraction and large-scale stakeholder signal analysis, serving as the storage layer. AlloyDB for PostgreSQL supports lower-latency interactive query paths across complex multi-year stakeholder analytics, serving as the storage layer. Gemini powers the Ask Genie copilot and interprets stakeholder signals into hyper-contextualized intelligence, serving as the compute layer. Google Kubernetes Engine keeps the global sensing platform highly available in production, serving as the orchestration layer.
